block_row: Integrates register and XIP interfaces with the shared serial engine.

frame_row: Source-derived QSPI master and read-only XIP target.

label: Register IF
(m_axi_qspi_reg_if)
blocks.function: Decodes software registers, stores control/interrupt state and contains TX/RX byte queues.

label: QSPI Engine
(m_axi_qspi_engine)
blocks.function: Sequences command/address/data phases and drives serial clock, chip select and data lanes.

label: XIP IF
(m_axi_qspi_mem_if)
blocks.function: Matches host reads to the flash window and packs serial bytes into AXI read beats.

interfaces.name: AXI register access
interfaces.signals: AW/W/AR requests and B/R responses; 32-bit single-beat profile.

interfaces.name: AXI XIP access
interfaces.signals: AR request and R response; read-only path.

interfaces.name: Serial flash pins
interfaces.signals: SCLK, active-low CS, four DQ output and input lanes.

interfaces.name: Completion/error interrupt
interfaces.signals: One active-high level from masked sticky causes.

interfaces.name: Clock and reset
interfaces.signals: One clock domain and active-low reset.

interfaces.name: Register control and status
interfaces.signals: Configuration/start flow to engine; busy/done/error status back.

interfaces.name: XIP request and receive flow
interfaces.signals: XIP command/offset request to engine; serial receive bytes and completion back.

legend_note: The register-interface block contains TX/RX FIFO instances in the source. Internal arrows show main request direction; CFG and MRQ interfaces also return status/data.
